Chapter 1162: Chapter 24: No Help Available (Request for Beginning-of-the-Month Guaranteed Monthly Votes)

A hidden Void Secret Realm.

The fiery flames imbued with the power of resurrection burned, coalescing into the figure of the Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

"Why did the Galaxy Great Saint only target me and the Shadow Demon?" The Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s thoughts could not settle.

As a wonder of life born from the Chaos Void, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint naturally possessed two avatars; the one wandering outside was his main combat body.

As for the one hidden in this Void Secret Realm? It was the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s other avatar.

In addition, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint had laid out life-saving measures in many corners of the Chaos Void, so even if both avatars fell, he could ’resurrect’ using these measures.

"Is it because the battles between me and the Shadow Demon led to the premature cataclysm of cosmoses?" The Nine Phoenix Great Saint mused to himself. Losing his main combat body was indeed a significant loss for him but not unacceptable.

When engaging in furious battle with the Shadow Demon Great Saint, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was already prepared to lose his main combat body.

Now that the main combat body had fallen, but so had the main combat body of the Shadow Demon Great Saint, this wasn’t the worst outcome for the Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

In fact, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was quite satisfied with this result; managing to take down a main combat body of the Shadow Demon Great Saint was a considerable success.

The path of chaos power that the Nine Phoenix Great Saint developed focused on survival, normally only able to restrain the Shadow Demon Great Saint, making mutual destruction very difficult.

What the Nine Phoenix Great Saint wanted to understand now was why the Galaxy Great Saint treated her and the Shadow Demon Great Saint differently compared to other Chaos Great Saints.

"Never mind, Galaxy Great Saint harbors murderous intent towards me and the Shadow Demon. Under such circumstances, if I continue to fight with the Shadow Demon, it may very likely attract the Galaxy Great Saint..."

A hint of madness appeared in the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s eyes. Her causal connection with the Shadow Demon Great Saint was deep, allowing her to sense the approximate location of the other’s avatar via their causal link.

"There."

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint looked in one direction, using causal sensing to determine the source of the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s cause, which was in that location.

Whoosh!

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s figure disappeared, heading directly towards the area where the Shadow Demon Great Saint was located.

...

"Does the Galaxy Great Saint sympathize with the beings of the cosmos affected and therefore targets us?"

The Shadow Demon Great Saint’s true form had an unsightly expression, deducing this conclusion from Lin Yuan’s last words.

He found it more and more incredible.

Such a powerful entity was actually this merciful?

"Hmm?"

At that moment, the Shadow Demon Great Saint’s expression changed, sharply raising his head to look in a certain direction.

The causal sensing between him and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was mutual; just as she could sense him, the Shadow Demon Great Saint could naturally sense her as well.

At this moment, the Shadow Demon Great Saint clearly noticed that the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s true form was approaching him at the fastest speed possible.

"Madwoman, Nine Phoenix, you lunatic."

The Shadow Demon Great Saint felt a chill on his scalp. Normally, losing his main combat avatar, one should hide and re-cultivate it.

Yet to deploy the last avatar without hesitation like the Nine Phoenix was simply incredible.

"Is this Nine Phoenix trying to draw the attention of the Galaxy Great Saint and intends to perish together with me?"

The Shadow Demon Great Saint immediately understood the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s intent.

Even if deploying her last avatar, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint could still do nothing to the Shadow Demon.

But as the two continued to fight, when the Galaxy Great Saint emerged from the Xuanhuang Universe, he would surely notice them first.

Given the Galaxy Great Saint’s evident disdain for them earlier, he might just pursue them easily.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint could do nothing to him, but the Galaxy Great Saint could.

However, in this case, the Shadow Demon Great Saint would die, and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint couldn’t escape either.

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint was acting with a mindset of mutual destruction to drag him down.

"Go."

The Shadow Demon Great Saint didn’t hesitate to traverse through space to a farther distance.

Now he dared not entangle himself with the Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

...

Ahead of a vast secret realm in a distant Void Domain.

A tall figure formed, precisely the incarnation of the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

As the Wild Barbarian Great Saint appeared in this place, he looked at the secret realm from afar.

The owner of this secret realm was a Chaos Great Saint, with strength surpassing that of the Wild Barbarian by a margin.

Soon.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint’s avatar entered the secret realm.

"Shi Guang brother." The Wild Barbarian Great Saint saw a three-eyed man.

This three-eyed man was known as the Stone Light Saint, who had, hundreds of Cosmic Eras ago, rampaged across many Void Domains. His combat power was exceedingly strong, reaching the pinnacle of Chaos Great Saint.

However, in the last hundred Cosmic Eras, the Stone Light Saint had hardly taken action, always in seclusion, preparing for a breakthrough to the thirteenth level.

"Wild Barbarian, you’ve come."

The Stone Light Saint glanced at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint and spoke.

"Hmm."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint nodded.

Outside, he was uninhibited, but in front of the Stone Light Saint, he was quite well-behaved.

"Stone Light brother’s strength is increasingly unfathomable. In my opinion, there is a great hope for breaking through to the thirteenth level. I hope you remember me when you become a life of time..."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint immediately flattered him.

"Thirteenth level?" The Stone Light Saint’s face showed a bit of a smile; no Chaos Great Saint would dislike hearing such words, and the supreme Great Saint was no exception.

"Let’s get straight to the point."

Stone Light Saint looked at the Wild Barbarian Great Saint.

"Stone Light Brother should know about my recent ordeal." Wild Barbarian Great Saint immediately said, "A Postnatal Universe emerged, and I rushed there with the power of the Eye of Myriad Laws. However, I was suppressed inside by an ancient Great Saint named ’Galaxy’. "

"Yes, I heard about it."

Stone Light Saint nodded.

"That ’Galaxy’ Great Saint demands I hand over ten billion chaos stones to release my main battle avatar. Stone Light Brother, you know I’m always broke, where can I get ten billion chaos stones?"

Wild Barbarian Great Saint sighed.

"Indeed."

Stone Light Saint nodded.

"Hmm?"

Wild Barbarian Great Saint looked at Stone Light Saint, was he just going to nod?

"Stone Light Brother, I came to you to ask if you could mediate with the Galaxy Great Saint. With your strength, Galaxy Great Saint would surely give you face."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint said, "I don’t demand to pay nothing, but ten billion chaos stones are too much. At least Galaxy Great Saint could reduce it to five billion, and I’m willing to offer another billion as your reward."

"You want me to negotiate with Galaxy Great Saint?" Stone Light Saint looked at Wild Barbarian Great Saint. "What if I get suppressed by Galaxy Great Saint too?"

"You get suppressed too?" Wild Barbarian Great Saint was slightly stunned, "With your strength, Stone Light Brother, it shouldn’t be possible, right?"

"Wild Barbarian, think again?" Stone Light Saint smiled, "Galaxy Great Saint managed to suppress eight Great Saints including you, almost holding Double Source as well. I can’t match up to that."

Stone Light Saint looked self-mockingly at Wild Barbarian Great Saint, "Wild Barbarian, I can’t help you with this."

"Stone Light Brother." Wild Barbarian Great Saint became anxious, "I can increase it to two billion chaos stones, no, three billion."

"I said, I can’t help." Stone Light Saint waved his hand, and this avatar of Wild Barbarian Great Saint was instantly moved outside the secret realm.

Rumble.

The entrance to the secret realm was rapidly closing.

"Stone Light Saint..."

Wild Barbarian Great Saint frowned, having no other option, he could only seek help from the next Chaos Great Saint.

...

"Black Light, you want me to help you?"

In a special, mysterious location, surrounded by a misty haze, a man with a blurry face sat upon a throne, looking down at the incarnation of Black Light Great Saint below.

"Yes."

"Back in the day, when we ventured together, I once saved you, and you said you owed me a favor."

Black Light Great Saint looked at the man sitting on the throne. This Chaos Great Saint’s power was already infinitely close to a Supreme Great Saint. If not for his unsuitable chaos power evolution path, he would already be a Supreme Great Saint.

"Yes, I owe you a favor."

The man sitting on the throne nodded, "But not for this matter."

"Not possible?"

Black Light Great Saint looked at him.

"Why don’t you ask a Supreme Great Saint to step in?" The man seated on the throne spoke.

"Ask a Supreme Great Saint?"

Black Light Great Saint shook his head, "That would cost more than just paying ten billion chaos stones directly."

The cost of asking a Supreme Great Saint to intervene would surely exceed ten billion chaos stones.

Black Light Great Saint wasn’t foolish and naturally wouldn’t engage in such a losing trade.

"Change the request." The man on the throne looked down at Black Light Great Saint, "Choose another matter."

"What else can I exchange for now?" Black Light Great Saint frowned, "My avatar is in the hands of Galaxy Great Saint."

"It’s still possible to exchange." The man sitting on the throne spoke, "For instance, letting me lend you a few billion chaos stones."

After speaking, the man added, "But it’s just a loan, you’ll have to repay it."

"...."

Black Light Great Saint fell into silence.

...

Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan examined the Dark Sky Heart in his hand.

The Dark Sky Heart is a treasure of the Supreme Great Saint level. Once thoroughly refined, it can form the Dark Sky Domain.

The power of the Dark Sky Domain far surpasses the Black Light Domain of Black Light Great Saint, even a common Chaos Great Saint who obtains the Dark Sky Heart.

Can instantly become a peak Great Saint. If a Supreme Great Saint refines the Dark Sky Heart, they can form a Dark Sky World, whose power won’t be much weaker than Lin Yuan’s external universe.

One must know, Lin Yuan’s external universe originates from his internal universe, and the internal universe, after absorbing and merging the source of the Fierce Sun, has been refined into the second layer of ’Infinite Void’, already comparable to the internal universe of a Supreme Great Saint.

The Dark Sky World condensed by the Dark Sky Heart acts as a supplement for those Supreme Great Saints who lack domain suppression methods.

However, compared to Lin Yuan’s internal universe, the upper limit of the Dark Sky World is fixed at its formation power, and Lin Yuan’s internal universe still has a lot of room for improvement.

"Now in this Xuanhuang Universe, there are only some Chaos Venerables left."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts moved slightly, as he dispatched a large number of avatars to different regions of the universe.

Since all Chaos Great Saints were dealt with, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t let go of the many treasures in the Xuanhuang Universe; at the very least, all the treasures recorded on that beast skin map must be obtained.

Hundreds of avatars went to collect treasures scattered throughout the universe.

Meanwhile, Lin Yuan’s true form headed directly to the deepest part of the Xuanhuang Universe, towards that tomb.
